Subject: What's next on your list?
Preview: A few things worth knowing before your next trip out.
Body: Hey,

You've been out there recently — or at least planning to be. Either way, we wanted to check in, not with a sales pitch, but with a straightforward note.

If you're mid-planning for a trip, we're here. If you've already been out and are starting to think about what's next, same deal.

We don't have a specific product to push on you today. What we do have is a catalog built around honest gear — stuff with real specs, real limits, and real use cases. Nothing oversold.

When you're ready to look at what fits your next route, head to the site. Filter by what actually matters to you: weight, capacity, conditions. We'll be straight with you about what each piece is and isn't built for.

Take your time. We'll be here.

— The Northbay Supply Team
Score 0-1; a score below 0.75 is a fail.
